description:
Slow Query Regression — WARN0301

Compares current slow-log average latency against the PFS historical baseline. Fires when current_avg_ms / pfs_avg_ms >= regression-factor (default 3x). Up to 5 regressions reported per tick.

prerequisites.description: Performance Schema query digest monitoring must be enabled for PFS-based regression detection (monitoring-performance-schema-queries=true)

config_keys.label: Timeframe (hours)
config_keys.help: Only slow log events within this rolling window are inspected.

config_keys.label: Regression factor (x)
config_keys.help: A query is flagged when its current slow-log average latency is this many times higher than its PFS historical average.

config_keys.label: Min PFS executions for baseline
config_keys.help: Query digests with fewer historical executions in PFS are excluded — not enough data for reliable baseline.
